source.title: More Dense Grinding Stones
source.objective:
Progress<name>, thank you for all the help you've given me.  I really can't thank you enough!

Although my need is no longer great... if you bring me more dense grinding stones, I still have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
source.completion: Again, thank you <name>.  Please enjoy these tickets, and tell your friends about the Darkmoon Faire!
